title: Heart Mountain Interpretive Center

services.name: school groups
services.desc: Heart Mountain Wyoming Landmark sits off Highway 14A, 15 minutes from Cody and 10 from Powell. As you approach Road 19, look for the historic red brick chimney on the hill and two large trees marking the turn. Follow Road 19, turn right onto the Interpretive Center’s road, and continue to the circular drive and parking lot. The Heart Mountain Wyoming Foundation relies on the support of our members and donors to advance our mission and take on new projects, including the restoration of original Heart Mountain structures. Join Heart Mountain in preserving the past, so that we can share all the lessons it holds for the future. Learn about the history of Japanese Americans in the United States

services.name: 2027 Stay and Play Package
services.desc: Do you, or someone you know, want to attend the 2027 Heart Mountain Pilgrimage? The Heart Mountain Wyoming Foundation is raffling a package for two that includes registration for next year’s event, 7 nights accommodation, a guided day trip to Yellowstone, a guided fly fishing outing, an evening of dinner & music,
